macros.name: Yinterspace
macros.doc: To give the Young-Tableaux extra-space (before and after) \y@interspace can be set to more than 0pt by calling \Yinterspace.

macros.name: Ystdtext
macros.doc: Use either the option stdtext to the \usepackage command to switch to roman letters or use the macro \Ystdtext with an argument of 1: \Ystdtext1.

macros.name: Yvcentermath
macros.doc: Say \Yvcentermath1 if you want vertical centering and \Yvcentermath0 to switch it off.
